lead.headline: On real change requests, the best coding agent fully finishes only about one task in four
lead.summary: Alibaba and several Asian universities built Co-Design Bench from real user requests to rework existing web apps, favouring ones users had to rephrase or roll back. GPT-6 Astra led the ten models, meeting about 70% of each task's requirements but fully solving only 26.4% of tasks. Scores fall as tasks mix layout, design, interaction and content changes, and the same model scored 75% or 56% on big overhauls depending on the harness, so the authors say to report model and harness together.

number_of_day.label: Share of repository-wide tasks that GPT-6 Astra, the top model on Co-Design Bench, fully completed. Older edit benchmarks now see near-perfect scores.

news.headline: Anthropic buys $3.4B of gas generators to power its data centres
news.summary: The Financial Times reports that Anthropic took over commitments for 1.7 GW of heavy-duty generators from Texas supplier OnePWR Solutions in late September, along with the engineering and construction capability to install them. It did not buy OnePWR itself. Neither company commented.

news.headline: DeepSeek's open-source agent app Harness hits 1.54M daily users
news.summary: Up from about 271,000 at the end of September, less than three months after launch. Harness burns about 92 trillion tokens a day, roughly 60 million per user, an early sign of how much more compute agents eat than chatbots. DeepSeek counts about 35,000 plugins and plans an official plugin marketplace.

news.headline: Nvidia's board opens an independent probe into reports about Jensen Huang
news.summary: A committee of independent directors with outside counsel will look into reporting that Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort; in a memo to staff he admitted an affair. Huang stays CEO, and the board says it has no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised. Results are due 17 November.

news.headline: Helsinki's Vensum Power raises €9M for near-lossless power converters
news.summary: Lifeline Ventures co-led the Series A with Larsen & Toubro and Eviny Ventures. Vensum's software-defined converters are built to stay efficient under fluctuating loads, and go into mass production at partner factories in 2027, first for EV charging and storage, then AI data centres.

writers_corner.title: Slavdom Unearthed: Marian Wawrzeniecki's Neopagan Paintings (1891–1923)
writers_corner.take: How a Kraków-trained history painter who was also a pioneering archaeologist let his digs reshape his art, until he was painting an imagined pagan Slavic past as Poland's true self.
writers_corner.quote: Although he was, by any measure, a minor painter, Wawrzeniecki was a majorly influential archaeologist
writers_corner.read_note: short essay plus a big image gallery
